user_story: As a transport analyst, I want to compare patronage recovery by mode since 2019, so that I can identify which modes remain below baseline.
app_feature: Mode and region filters plus indexed line chart

user_story: As a policy adviser, I want to identify which modes are weakest in the latest month, so that I can prioritise follow-up analysis.
As a reviewer, I want to see the data source and limitations, so that I can judge whether the app is appropriate for my use.
